{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Texas cuisine|Texas cuisine]]

If you've ever been in Texas and tried one of their chicken-fried steaks, you'll know that they are amazing! They're crispy on the outside, tender, smoky, and peppery with a little heat on the inside and smothered in a rich cream gravy. It's just amazing.

== Ingredients ==
* 3 [[Cookbook:Beef|beef]] cube steaks, ½-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] thick
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] freshly ground [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]], divided
* 2 tbsp smoked [[Cookbook:Paprika|paprika]]
* 1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Cayenne Pepper|cayenne pepper]]
* 3 tbsp [[Cookbook:Bacon|bacon]] [[Cookbook:Drippings|drippings]], divided
* 1 cup chicken [[Cookbook:Broth|broth]]
* 1 cup whole [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]], combined with ¼ cup [[Cookbook:Heavy Cream|heavy cream]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]], beaten
* [[Cookbook:All-purpose flour|All-purpose flour]], plus 3 tbsp

== Procedure ==
#Season steaks with salt and 2 tbsp freshly ground black pepper.
#In a [[Cookbook:Pie and Tart Pans|pie plate]], combine eggs with paprika and cayenne. Dip steaks into egg mixture.
#In another pie plate, place some all-purpose flour. [[Cookbook:Dredging|Dredge]] battered steaks with flour.
#Move to a cooling rack and let rest 10–15 minutes. Wash this once you start frying, or get a clean one.
#Heat a 12 inch cast-iron [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|skillet]] over medium high heat. Once hot, pour in 2 tbsp drippings. Add steaks in a triangle formation around the edges of the pan. Fry for 4 minutes per side.
#Remove steaks from pan and drain on a cooling rack above a [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|sheet pan]]. Keep steaks warm in a 250°F [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]].
#Add remaining drippings and 3 tbsp flour. [[Cookbook:Whisk|Whisk]] continuously until blonde color is achieved.
#Add chicken broth and deglaze pan. Bring to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]] over medium heat until reduced by ¾.
#Add milk mixture and remaining black pepper. Keep over medium heat until gravy coats back of spoon.
#Remove steaks to serving platters and drizzle with gravy. Serve warm.

steps.text: Season steaks with salt and 2 tbsp freshly ground black pepper.
In a pie plate, combine eggs with paprika and cayenne. Dip steaks into egg mixture.
In another pie plate, place some all-purpose flour. Dredge battered steaks with flour.
Move to a cooling rack and let rest 10–15 minutes. Wash this once you start frying, or get a clean one.
Heat a 12 inch cast-iron skillet over medium high heat. Once hot, pour in 2 tbsp drippings. Add steaks in a triangle formation around the edges of the pan. Fry for 4 minutes per side.
Remove steaks from pan and drain on a cooling rack above a sheet pan. Keep steaks warm in a 250°F oven.
Add remaining drippings and 3 tbsp flour. Whisk continuously until blonde color is achieved.
Add chicken broth and deglaze pan. Bring to a boil over medium heat until reduced by ¾.
Add milk mixture and remaining black pepper. Keep over medium heat until gravy coats back of spoon.
Remove steaks to serving platters and drizzle with gravy. Serve warm.
